## PR Checklist

- [ ] `cargo xtask pr` passes
- [ ] Tests cover valid input, invalid input and the boundary between them, and each opens with a
      description of its goal and method
- [ ] New functions assert their arguments, results and invariants
- [ ] Every new loop and queue has a fixed bound, and new memory is allocated at start-up

- [ ] Documentation updated
- [ ] Breaking changes listed
